checks.name: english-source-labels:cvpr2023-shapley:original-proof
detail: The supplement defines the beta integral for positive parameters but prints exponent 1-q where q-1 is required. At p=1,q=2 the printed integral diverges while its claimed factorial value is finite. Other steps use a zero beta parameter and identify an integral as one at an empty set although its integrand is zero. An extreme empty remaining universe also requires an explicit empty-sum case.These are errors in the proofs of the factorial coefficients, not counterexamples to Theorems 2–4. The repaired finite convolution proves the original conclusions, including boundary cases, without introducing integral domain assumptions.View source核验记录 ↗

The source converts constrained sparsity minimization to a penalized problem without choosing a multiplier or establishing a suitable equivalence. In a generic discrete optimization example with (support,error) pairs (0,3),(1,2),(2,0), a budget of one selects the middle point, but making it minimize error plus multiplier times support requires the multiplier to be both at most one and at least two.This example establishes the failure of generic equivalence, without claiming that the three points are realized by the paper’s DNN. The source conversion remains a heuristic; the missing model-specific equivalence is not supplied as an assumption.View source核验记录 ↗
